test_enter_fullscreen.title: Verify clicking zoom icon enters full screen and video streams.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Views > Live Playback Controls
steps.expected: Live Playback Controls page loads without errors

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully render
Locate the relevant UI area for exit and re-enter fullscreen works correctly
steps.expected: The target section or element is visible

steps.action: Verify exit and re-enter fullscreen works correctly is displayed and functions correctly
steps.expected: Exit and re-enter fullscreen works correctly is displayed as expected

steps.action: Verify no errors or unexpected behavior occurred
steps.expected: Page remains stable with no console errors

test_exit_fullscreen.title: Verify exiting full screen returns to the views grid

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen, then click exit.
steps.expected: The exit button is gone, the add-tab button is back and the address is the site root.

test_fullscreen_pause_play.title: Verify timeline controls are present in full screen

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen.
steps.expected: In live mode the bar shows exactly one live-mode pause control; in archive mode exactly one play control.

test_fullscreen_controls_visible.title: Verify player controls are visible in full screen

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen.
steps.expected: The bar shows the exit, bookmarks-dots and volume controls, and its icon set includes exitFullScreen, dotsIcon and a volumn icon.

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully render

steps.action: Scroll to the area where Live indicator should appear
steps.expected: The relevant section of the page is in view
